mapper.select: SELECT provider, model_name, COUNT(*) AS call_count, SUM(CASE WHEN success = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS success_count, SUM(CASE WHEN success = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS failed_count, COALESCE(SUM(total_tokens), 0) AS total_tokens, COALESCE(ROUND(AVG(latency_ms)), 0) AS average_latency_ms, MAX(create_time) AS last_call_time FROM ai_model_call_record WHERE deleted = 0 GROUP BY provider, model_name
